description.narrative: As per MTR - By 2023, Governments in the Gulf countries have strengthened capacity to collect timely, quality and diss data, carry out child-focused research and evaluation to inform policy, plans and monitoring of the Sustainable Development Goals. By 2023, government ministries, academia and research institutions have strengthened capacities for child-focused research, analysis and knowledge sharing.
